title: Law to allow new shared housing with private rooms
summary: This bill would let developers build "shared housing" starting January 1, 2027, where two or more private rooming units share a kitchen and bathroom in new or converted apartment buildings. It sets rules covering room size, occupancy limits, fire protection, cooking equipment, management and building design, adding a new appendix to the building code. Short-term rentals would not be allowed in these shared rooming units.
